in_sanskrit.name: Nandini
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who delights the heart or gives a fresh and new feeling

in_hindi.name: नन्दिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: She who bestows happiness or is a source of happiness, also known as Masoodi (one who is not in need)

in_tamil.name: நந்தினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: She who has beautiful and charming features, she who is playful, and she who is in a state of love and happiness

in_telugu.name: నందినీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who is auspicious, she who is the embodiment of grace, and she who is the Goddess of prosperity

in_marathi.name: Nandhini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of Heaven
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandhini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nandhini is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Nectar of Heaven'. In Hindu mythology, Nandini is the name of Shiva's bull or the goddess Parvati's mount. It is also the name of a female demon, who was later tamed and transformed into a goddess.
